topics.description: Connect personal AI clients to apps through Composio For You.

guides.title: Use Tool Router session files as toolkit inputs
guides.description: Convert session file paths into fresh FileUploadable storage keys before calling toolkit actions.

sources.sourceHeading: Session paths are not `FileUploadable` storage keys

guides.title: Pagination limits are endpoint-specific
guides.description: Use each endpoint's schema and cursor behavior instead of assuming one global page-size limit.

sources.sourceHeading: Pagination limits are endpoint-specific

guides.title: Deduplicate trigger webhook deliveries
guides.description: Build idempotent trigger handlers because outbound webhook delivery is at-least-once.

sources.sourceHeading: Trigger webhook delivery is at-least-once

guides.title: Custom connection-data fields are toolkit-specific
guides.description: Read each toolkit's auth metadata instead of assuming every API key uses the same field name.

sources.sourceHeading: Field names are toolkit-specific

guides.title: Ahrefs actions must use the API host
guides.description: Ahrefs API v3 requests must use api.ahrefs.com rather than the Ahrefs website host.

sources.sourceHeading: Ahrefs actions must call api.ahrefs.com, not ahrefs.com

guides.title: Use CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE for invitee creation
guides.description: Replace the deprecated Calendly invitee action with CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE.

sources.sourceHeading: Use CALENDLY_POST_INVITEE instead of deprecated CALENDLY_CREATE_EVENT_INVITEE

guides.title: Use Canva autofill jobs for design content
guides.description: Populate a Canva design with an autofill job instead of a blank create-design action.

sources.sourceHeading: Use Canva autofill jobs when content must be populated into a design

guides.title: Granola MCP metadata comes from the upstream server
guides.description: Composio can expose only the tools and schemas declared by Granola's official MCP server.

sources.sourceHeading: Composio mirrors Granola's official MCP server

guides.title: Inspect Odoo JSON-RPC errors inside HTTP 200 responses
guides.description: Check the JSON-RPC envelope because transport success does not guarantee Odoo method success.

sources.sourceHeading: JSON-RPC access errors can arrive inside HTTP 200 responses

guides.title: Strava athlete limits belong to the OAuth app
guides.description: Connected-athlete capacity is attached to the Strava developer application behind the auth config.

sources.sourceHeading: Athlete-limit errors belong to the OAuth application

guides.title: Auth-config list pages return at most 50 items
guides.description: Follow next_cursor when listing auth configs and verify the deployed page-size limit.

sources.sourceHeading: Auth-config list pages return at most 50 items

guides.title: Fix HubSpot OAuth token exchange 400 errors
guides.description: Check a customer-owned HubSpot OAuth app's secret, redirect URI, and required or optional scope alignment.

sources.sourceHeading: HubSpot OAuth token-fetch 400: check client secret and required-scope alignment

guides.title: Fix Shopify authorization failures on new integrations
guides.description: Use a current Shopify OAuth or client-credentials flow rather than copying an Admin API token.

sources.sourceHeading: Shopify API-key/admin-token auth is deprecated; use OAuth2 or S2S auth instead

guides.title: Discord or DiscordBot: which toolkit to connect
guides.description: Bot-token operations need the DiscordBot toolkit; user-authorized OAuth operations need Discord.

sources.sourceHeading: Discord and DiscordBot use different token types
Discord message triggers require bot-token auth, but Discord OAuth trigger support has been limited

guides.title: Read an Outlook shared mailbox instead of the signed-in user's
guides.description: Pass the shared mailbox address as the mailbox target. It selects the mailbox but does not grant access to it.

sources.sourceHeading: For Outlook shared mailboxes, pass the shared mailbox address as `user_id`/mailbox target

guides.title: Why Google Sheets access cannot be limited to one Drive folder
guides.description: A Drive folder is not an OAuth boundary. Narrow access with drive.file or an application-level allowlist instead.

sources.sourceHeading: Google Sheets access cannot be restricted at folder level through Composio

guides.title: Fix Google Calendar errors when "me" is used as the calendar ID
guides.description: Use primary for the signed-in user's calendar. me is not a valid Google Calendar ID.

sources.sourceHeading: Use `primary` as calendar ID; `me` is not valid for calendar ID

guides.title: Use full Google OAuth scope URIs in Google Sheets auth configs
guides.description: Enter provider-published full OAuth scope URIs rather than shorthand path values.

sources.sourceHeading: Use full Google scope URLs such as `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive`, not shorthand `/drive`

guides.title: Use a Stripe secret key for Composio API-key connections
guides.description: Provide a Stripe secret key from Standard keys for a server-side Stripe API-key connection.

sources.sourceHeading: For Stripe API-key auth, use the Stripe secret key from Developers -> API Keys -> Standard keys

guides.title: Enter the Snowflake Account ID as org-account
guides.description: Use the current Composio connection field's hostname-label form without a URL prefix or Snowflake domain suffix.

sources.sourceHeading: Use one Snowflake auth config per customer account for multi-tenant SaaS OAuth
Fetch connected-account fields or toolkit metadata to discover Snowflake account details

guides.title: Fix Instagram posts failing on local image or video files
guides.description: Stage local media with image_file or video_file. A filesystem path or session URL is not a media URL.

sources.sourceHeading: Publish local media with `image_file` or `video_file`

guides.title: Resolve Canvas account-endpoint access errors by checking the account-level role
guides.description: Verify the connected identity has the provider's account-level role before diagnosing an account endpoint as a Composio failure.

sources.sourceHeading: `CANVAS_GET_ACCOUNTS` and other account-level Canvas endpoints require admin permissions

guides.title: Paginate Canvas list results instead of assuming one response is complete
guides.description: Use a Canvas action's current pagination fields and stop only when its returned pagination signal ends.

sources.sourceHeading: Canvas list/fetch endpoints follow Canvas pagination behavior and may need `per_page`

guides.title: Fix Slack returning no private channel or DM history
guides.description: Each private conversation type needs its own history scope, and the app must also be a member of the conversation.

sources.sourceHeading: Private Slack channels and DMs require extra history scopes

guides.title: Fix Slack admin conversation write failures
guides.description: Confirm Enterprise Grid, org-wide installation, administrator role, and token scope for Slack admin conversation writes.

sources.sourceHeading: `admin.conversations:write` requires Slack Enterprise

guides.title: Fix LinkedIn 403 errors on company page actions
guides.description: Company-page actions need the organization scope on the token, an eligible Page role, and the matching app permission.

sources.sourceHeading: LinkedIn organization scopes depend on the toolkit and auth config

guides.title: Fix LinkedIn 426 NONEXISTENT_VERSION errors
guides.description: Use latest only to diagnose a stale LinkedIn toolkit version, then pin the dated version your application validated.

sources.sourceHeading: Fix LinkedIn 426 NONEXISTENT_VERSION by using the latest toolkit version

guides.title: Batch Airtable multi-record updates in groups of 10
guides.description: Split Web API-backed Airtable multi-record updates into independently handled batches of 10 or fewer.

sources.sourceHeading: AIRTABLE_UPDATE_MULTIPLE_RECORDS updates at most 10 records per call

guides.title: Fix "Toolkit 'quickbooks' is disabled for this session"
guides.description: QuickBooks is categorized under Payment Processing, so a session that excludes payment tools disables the whole toolkit, including read-only accounting tools.

sources.sourceHeading: QuickBooks can be disabled by the MCP Payment Processing session policy

guides.title: Fix QuickBooks requests that resolve to /v3/company/None/
guides.description: QuickBooks company IDs arrive as OAuth connection metadata rather than a per-tool argument, so a missing realm ID shows up in the request path.

sources.sourceHeading: QuickBooks tools require connection-level company metadata
Realm ID mapping fixes may require the latest QuickBooks toolkit version

guides.title: Connect a QuickBooks sandbox company
guides.description: Sandbox QuickBooks connections need Intuit's sandbox API base URL passed at connection initiation.

sources.sourceHeading: Use the sandbox QuickBooks API base URL for sandbox connections
QuickBooks auth can accept custom auth and token URLs for sandbox/custom flows

guides.title: Connect multiple QuickBooks companies to one project
guides.description: Give each QuickBooks company its own connected account and target it explicitly from MCP clients.

sources.sourceHeading: Multiple QuickBooks accounts can be selected in Claude/MCP by using separate user IDs or connected account IDs

guides.title: Fix QuickBooks OAuth failures caused by the payments scope
guides.description: The QuickBooks payments scope requires the payment module to be enabled on the Intuit account and app.

sources.sourceHeading: QuickBooks payment scope requires payment module access
QuickBooks auth configs need QuickBooks credentials and matching redirect URL

guides.title: Add the Google Ads developer token to the auth config
guides.description: The Google Ads developer token now lives on the auth config, so connections made through older auth configs fail.

sources.sourceHeading: Google Ads developer token now belongs on the auth config, not connection initiation
Google Ads API requires both OAuth access token and developer token

guides.title: Fix Google Ads 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors
guides.description: Google Ads rate limits can come from Google's own quota or from shared managed-OAuth capacity, not from your Composio plan.

sources.sourceHeading: Google Ads 429s can come from Google's shared OAuth/developer-token limits, not Composio plan limits

guides.title: Target a Google Ads sub-account under an MCC
guides.description: Pass customer_id per call to target a child account, and let the connection supply the manager context.

sources.sourceHeading: Google Ads MCC/sub-account customer ID targeting is supported

guides.title: Fix Google Ads campaign mutate INVALID_ARGUMENT errors
guides.description: Budget and location fields sent inline on a Campaign mutate are rejected by Google; they belong to separate resources.

sources.sourceHeading: Campaign mutate 400s can be caused by unsupported inline Campaign fields

guides.title: Connect TikTok with your own developer app
guides.description: TikTok connections generally require your own TikTok developer app, with URL-prefix verification on a domain you control.

sources.sourceHeading: TikTok is supported, but customers generally need their own TikTok developer app
TikTok URL-prefix verification must be done on a customer-owned redirect domain, not Composio's shared callback domain
Public TikTok posting requires the customer's own app to pass TikTok's content posting audit

guides.title: Fix TikTok client_key errors during OAuth
guides.description: TikTok returns client_key errors for credential mismatches and redirect URI problems in its own authorize step.

sources.sourceHeading: TikTok OAuth uses `client_key`; credential mismatch or old `client_id` handling causes `client_key` errors
TikTok app status, scopes, and sandbox/production mode determine who can complete OAuth

guides.title: Request only the TikTok scopes your app is approved for
guides.description: A custom TikTok auth config that falls back to the full default scope set fails when the app is approved for a subset.

sources.sourceHeading: TikTok custom auth must request only approved scopes

guides.title: Connect Reddit with your own OAuth credentials
guides.description: Reddit connections are most reliable with your own client ID and secret, which also insulates you from shared-app enforcement.

sources.sourceHeading: Reddit supports OAuth 2.0 custom credentials in auth configs
Reddit toolkit behavior can change when Reddit changes its API or enforcement policies

guides.title: Fix Reddit create-post failures that ask for flair_id
guides.description: Old Reddit tool versions require flair_id on post creation; current versions do not.

sources.sourceHeading: Older Reddit Create Post tool versions may require `flair_id`

guides.title: Fix Google "app is blocked" errors on sensitive Gmail scopes
guides.description: Composio's managed Gmail OAuth app is not verified for every sensitive Gmail scope; verified scopes need your own Google OAuth app.

sources.sourceHeading: Use your own OAuth app for unverified sensitive Gmail scopes
Create Gmail custom OAuth auth config, then initiate a connection with callback URL

guides.title: Create Gmail filters with the gmail.settings.basic scope
guides.description: GMAIL_CREATE_FILTER requires gmail.settings.basic; broader mailbox scopes do not substitute for it.

sources.sourceHeading: Creating Gmail filters requires `gmail.settings.basic`

guides.title: Send Gmail from a send-as alias
guides.description: Use from_email on GMAIL_SEND_EMAIL to pick a configured send-as alias.

sources.sourceHeading: Use `from_email` to select Gmail send-as alias
Use `me` for Gmail `user_id` in tool calls

guides.title: Reduce Gmail fetch payload size
guides.description: Trim Gmail list and fetch responses with include_payload, verbose, only_ids, queries, and result limits.

sources.sourceHeading: Reduce Gmail fetch payload size with `include_payload=false`, `verbose=false`, `only_ids`, query, and limits
Avoid `gmail.metadata` when fetching full Gmail email content

guides.title: SharePoint REST and SharePoint Graph need separate connections
guides.description: The two SharePoint toolkits call different Microsoft APIs, so their tokens and scopes are not interchangeable.

sources.sourceHeading: SharePoint REST APIs and SharePoint Graph are separate API families

guides.title: Fix SharePoint 404s on /teams/ sites
guides.description: A bare subsite value resolves to /sites/, so team sites need the full server-relative path.

sources.sourceHeading: `/teams/` SharePoint sites require the server-relative Subsite path

guides.title: Set the SharePoint tenant when creating a connection
guides.description: Composio does not derive the SharePoint tenant from the OAuth token, so it must be passed at connection initiation.

sources.sourceHeading: Pass the SharePoint tenant/subdomain during connection initiation
SharePoint `.default` scope uses the tenant domain placeholder
Retrieve SharePoint site name from connected account state

guides.title: Choose which connected account a Tool Router session uses
guides.description: Assign account aliases and pass one explicitly, or a session with several eligible accounts picks its default.

sources.sourceHeading: Select among multiple accounts with an alias or account ID
Connected-account selection is live unless pinned
The session user must match the connected-account user

guides.title: Fix "Toolkit '<name>' is not allowed" in a session
guides.description: Session toolkit allowlists are checked before auth configs and connected accounts.

sources.sourceHeading: Toolkit allowlists are enforced before connection lookup

guides.title: Tool Router session lifetime and deletion
guides.description: Sessions are long-lived records without time-based expiry, and deleting one does not remove its connections.

sources.sourceHeading: Session lifetime and deletion

guides.title: Connect Meta Ads with your own app credentials
guides.description: Meta Ads has no Composio-managed OAuth app, so connections need your own Meta developer app.

sources.sourceHeading: Meta Ads does not have a managed OAuth app; use your own credentials
Meta OAuth issues can require adding the Composio redirect URI in the Meta app settings
API-key connections can show ACTIVE before MetaAds credentials are live-verified

guides.title: Change which Facebook or Instagram account is connected
guides.description: Meta connections bind to the account chosen in Meta's picker and cannot be repointed from Composio.

sources.sourceHeading: Facebook or Instagram connections authenticate the account selected in Meta's picker and cannot be repointed server-side

guides.title: Connect X (Twitter) with your own developer app
guides.description: X connections require your own developer app credentials and a Platform auth config rather than Connect.

sources.sourceHeading: Twitter/X no longer supports Composio managed OAuth; customers must use their own developer app credentials
Twitter/X cannot be used through Connect when it requires custom OAuth credentials
`client-not-enrolled` and `App not linked to project` usually point to Twitter developer app/project setup issues

guides.title: Connect Xero with your own OAuth app
guides.description: Xero connections need your own OAuth app credentials, a Web app type, and an exactly matching redirect URI.

sources.sourceHeading: Xero managed OAuth was removed/limited; use your own Xero OAuth app credentials
Xero OAuth app should be a Web app and the client secret must match the auth config
Remove deprecated Xero scopes that cause invalid-scope/CSP/login errors

guides.title: Fix Jira credentials that expire without refreshing
guides.description: Atlassian needs audience=api.atlassian.com and offline_access before it will issue a Jira refresh token.

sources.sourceHeading: Missing `audience=api.atlassian.com` can prevent Jira refresh tokens

guides.title: Add offline_access to Confluence auth configs
guides.description: Confluence token refresh requires the offline_access scope, and it only applies to connections made after the change.

sources.sourceHeading: Add `offline_access` to Confluence auth configs when refresh tokens are needed
Use connected account ID, not auth config ID, when executing Confluence tools

guides.title: Why managed Google Drive access only sees some files
guides.description: Composio's default Google Drive credentials can use drive.file, which only reaches files the app created or was granted.

sources.sourceHeading: Managed Google Drive credentials may use narrower Drive scopes than full-drive access
Use `GOOGLEDRIVE_GET_ABOUT` to confirm which Google Drive account is connected

guides.title: Connect a GitHub App
guides.description: GitHub Apps need a separate install step that Composio's connection flow does not expose.

sources.sourceHeading: GitHub Apps need an install step and are not fully supported in Composio's connection flow

guides.title: Gemini toolkit quota is shared unless you bring your own key
guides.description: Gemini toolkit calls can run on shared Composio credentials, so you can hit provider limits at low personal usage.

sources.sourceHeading: Gemini toolkit uses shared credentials and quota unless BYOK/custom key support is available
Gemini no-auth/toolkit usage is counted as regular Composio tool calls
